method.window_rule: all consecutive 7-session windows over the local project calendar
method.deduplication: field pairs and effective trading dates are deduplicated across overlapping windows
limitations: Overlapping windows are repeated views of shared source snapshots, not independent replications.
Early windows have incomplete source coverage; intraday and unknown-phase samples were excluded from L1 adjudication.
Every row remains an exploratory candidate until a verified_anchor_only report and human semantic review support an explicit decision.
